'''2007 US East Nationals Day 1 Damian Loback DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Damian Loback]] at [[2007 US East Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Damian ?abach
* '''Deck name:''' A Pile of Random
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
